component.name: QuackSlicer
component.summary: 3D printing software with physical filament and order tracking

description.p: QuackSlicer is an independent OrcaSlicer fork with physical filament inventory, Home Assistant integration and customer order tracking.

It builds on OrcaSlicer by SoftFever and the OrcaSlicer contributors, which in turn builds on Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer and Slic3r. Upstream project information and support for upstream development are available from the OrcaSlicer project.
